# Mallan NYC — Copilot Instructions

Before proposing or changing code in this repository, read in order:

1. `AI-START-HERE.md`
2. `AGENTS.md`
3. `docs/architecture/Mallan_Intelligence_Master_Plan.md`
4. `docs/PROJECT-HEALTH-DASHBOARD.md`
5. `docs/PLATFORM-ISSUE-REGISTRY.md`
6. The latest `docs/operations/site-audit-handoff-YYYY-MM-DD.md`
7. `docs/compliance/COMPLIANCE-CANONICAL-INDEX.md` for compliance-shaped work
8. `NEON.md` for database, Prisma, migration, projection, cron, Neon, or Vercel-database work

Do not rely on chat memory, stale comments, historical plans, copied Cotality values, or inferred REBNY behavior. The live Cotality API and repository verification process are the provider authority. Stop and report when a required canonical rule or file is missing or conflicting.

The master plan defines the target architecture; it does not prove current implementation. Verify current `main`, current PR head, tests, and runtime behavior before making factual or completion claims.
